headlines.text: City of London Corporation has London's highest concentration of specialty coffee: 26 venues, 5.69x the London rate.
Haringey leads on bakeries and bagel shops: 1.9x the London rate.
City of London Corporation has the most wine, craft and cocktail bars for its size (3.11x London).
Lambeth is where plant-based places cluster (2.48x London).
CR4 looks like a scene that is still growing: 4.5 specialty, bakery, craft or plant-based places per 100 venues and 26.0% of venues new or newly run.
Emerging, lots of openings but the scene has not formed yet: IG3, NW9, IG1.
Established scenes with little new supply: N13, E17, N4.
City of London Corporation is the most chain-heavy borough, by the national chains we track (8.5% of venues) and Hackney the least (1.9%). London overall: 4.4%.
CR4 has the freshest supply: 26.0% of its 154 venues are awaiting a first inspection.
Pace of change needs 14 days of daily snapshots to call a trend; 2 so far.

method: Keyword matches on premises names within eating and drinking premises, and share of premises awaiting their first FSA inspection. Proxies: a name can mislead, and awaiting inspection also covers changes of operator.
